methods_quotes.q: Analyses of rate changes used z-tests when deaths were ≥100 and nonoverlapping confidence intervals based on a gamma distribution when deaths were <100.
Age-adjusted death rates were calculated by applying age-specific death rates to the 2000 U.S. Census standard population age distribution
Changes presented in text represent statistically significant (p<0.05) findings unless otherwise specified.
Deaths involving more than one type of drug were included in the rates for each applicable drug category; categories are not mutually exclusive.
The method of comparing confidence intervals is a conservative method for statistical significance
